artifact: F-5.3A design only (no model invoked): how Pass B / accountability must consume a dual-pass support-aware inventory, the freeze semantics, and the architectural comparison against a hypothetical adjudicator

passBContract.invariant: Pass B must account for EVERY canonical union proposition. SINGLE_RUN propositions are authoritative inventory: they are consumed or dispositioned exactly like corroborated ones. Support status is provenance, never a filter.
passBContract.compilerContext: the frozen inventory lines Pass B already receives gain a support tag per item ([CORROBORATED] / [SINGLE_RUN pass-2] / [CONFLICTED with <id>]); the accountability obligation text is unchanged (consume or disposition every CRITICAL/MATERIAL item); a CONFLICTED pair is presented as two items with an explicit conflict note and the instruction to disposition BOTH as AMBIGUOUS unless the source itself resolves the conflict - Pass B never picks a side.

reconciliationExposure.REPRESENTED x SINGLE_RUN: represented singleton item - full accountability credit, but the unit stays REVIEW_REQUIRED for support asymmetry until independently resolved
reconciliationExposure.UNSUPPORTED x CORROBORATED: unsupported corroborated item - as today (UNSUPPORTED never earns credit)
reconciliationExposure.UNSUPPORTED x SINGLE_RUN: unsupported singleton item - as today, plus support asymmetry
reconciliationExposure.MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION x CORROBORATED: missing corroborated item - semantic incompleteness (as today)
reconciliationExposure.MISSING_FROM_COMPOSITION x SINGLE_RUN: missing singleton item - semantic incompleteness; NEVER excused by its singleton status
reconciliationExposure.CONFLICTED (any disposition): conflict - REVIEW_REQUIRED; a REPRESENTED disposition of one side does not resolve the conflict

passBContract.reconciliationItemAdditiveFields: ReconciliationItem gains support?: ItemSupport copied from the inventory item (same additive shape as SemanticInventoryItem.support); rollup gains counts of represented/unsupported/missing by support status and a conflicts count; SemanticAccountabilityResult.trust gains supportReviewRequired (true when any CRITICAL/MATERIAL item is SINGLE_RUN or CONFLICTED) that maps to REVIEW_REQUIRED exactly like an unresolved cross-reference does today
passBContract.resolutionOfSupportAsymmetry: only by (a) the independent semantic verifier confirming the singleton against the source, (b) human approval recorded as a reviewer correction, or (c) another certified mechanism; never by Pass B consuming it, never by a third model run 'voting'
passBContract.generalCovenantIR: unchanged - support provenance rides on the inventory/reconciliation side only
passBContract.freezeSemantics: the ensemble's frozenContentHash covers canonical propositions (id, semanticFunctions signature, materiality, source span, values), support (status + sorted supporting passes + sorted member ids per pass), the union's own unaccounted source and uninventoried values, and the input pass hashes; it is computed over a sorted part list so Union(pass-1, pass-2) and Union(pass-2, pass-1) hash identically (proven on the paid pair and every control); frozenAt is excluded from equality
passBContract.versioning: algorithmVersion = '<pass algorithm>+semantic-ensemble.v1'; passHashes pin the exact input evidence; a later re-ensemble with a different reconciliation version changes the hash
passBContract.passIdentifiers: generic, caller-supplied (e.g. pass-1 / pass-2 or any label); semantics never key on a literal label; the ensemble sorts pass ids so labels are order-free

A_supportAwareUnion.recall: union of both passes - nothing either pass found is dropped (paid pair: 50/50 F omissions retained, frozen reference recall 1.0)
A_supportAwareUnion.provenance: every canonical item lists its supporting passes and member ids; the freeze hash binds them
A_supportAwareUnion.conservativeTrust: singletons and conflicts force REVIEW_REQUIRED; raw coverage recomputed over the union stays authoritative (paid pair: 19 both-run gaps still block)
A_supportAwareUnion.auditability: an auditor can reconstruct which pass said what for every item without re-running anything
A_supportAwareUnion.silentDeletion: none by construction; INTERSECTION_ONLY (the delete rule) was measured and rejected: it would drop 45 of 50 omitted propositions and lower quantitative reference recall to 0.9333

B_adjudicateToOneAnswer.recall: bounded above by the union and reduced whenever the adjudicator sides against a genuine singleton; on the paid pair 112 material singletons would each be a coin the adjudicator must call
B_adjudicateToOneAnswer.provenance: lost unless the adjudicator's inputs and decision are themselves frozen - a third stochastic layer that itself needs a stability proof
B_adjudicateToOneAnswer.conservativeTrust: converts explicit support asymmetry back into an unmarked single answer: a wrong adjudication is a silent omission again (exactly the F-5 failure mode)
B_adjudicateToOneAnswer.auditability: requires trusting the adjudicator's judgment; disagreements are not visible after the fact
B_adjudicateToOneAnswer.silentDeletion: inherent: every adjudicated-away singleton is deleted without a raw-coverage trace when a broader item covers its text (34 of the 50 F cases were exactly that shape)

adjudicationComparison.conclusion: the support-aware union dominates on every property the mission lists; an adjudicator is at best a later, separately certified RESOLUTION mechanism for singletons (section 6), never the discovery unit. Not implemented.
